name: 学習結果に合う本の提案
prompt:
Use Reference 1 as the current candidate to edit. Reference 2 is authoritative for exact 390×290 content and bounds. Reference 3 is the exact original book-cover bitmap; place it unchanged, pixel-for-pixel, in the book-cover position. Do not repaint, redraw, simplify, recolor, crop or add a band to the cover. Its own original artwork includes a cream horizontal stripe; keep that only within the cover image.

Correct the card to match the native preview: 390×290 white canvas; card x=16, y=8, width=358, height=272, 4 px corners and 1 px solid #047857 outline. Keep canvas, card interior and every UI surface pure white #FFFFFF, with no pale tint, cream, mint, blush, gray fill, gradient, shadow, glow or texture. The cover's original colors are protected artwork, not a UI background.

Align heading at x=32/y=22, size 326×28, Meiryo Bold 20/28, exact text “次の一歩のために学ぶ”. Align supporting line at x=32/y=60, 326×16, Meiryo Regular 12/16, exact text “この結果に合わせた学びのヒント”. Place the exact supplied cover at x=32/y=92, 66×101, with no crop or distortion. Book title x=116/y=94, 242×24, Meiryo Regular 14/24, “お金との付き合い方を学ぶ”. Author x=116/y=128, 242×16, Meiryo Regular 12/16, gray #6E6E6E, “ラミット・セティ”. Metadata x=116/y=162, 242×16, Meiryo Regular 12/16, gray #6E6E6E, “15分　・　8つの学び”. Buttons stay at x=32/y=208, 152×52, and x=202/y=208, 152×52; radius 10, flat solid #047857 with centered white Meiryo Regular 14/24 labels “聞く” and “読む”.

Use the native preview to correct the slightly over-wide outline and the heading/supporting line that were too low in Reference 1. Preserve all other content and spacing. No phone frame, extra page chrome, icons or decorative content. Return only this component.
reviewNotes: Pure-white UI confirmed; cover visually closer to supplied art; heading and support line remain low after one correction.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
